parameters.description: Also remove the servers of an offline node from the panel. Their files stay on the machine.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Where to put the file, e.g. plugins/x.jar

needsSetup.description: True until the owner account was created via the setup link

token.description: Token from the setup link in the identity service log

discord.description: Display name of the linked Discord account
Display name of the linked Discord account

permissions.description: What this user may do (ADR 0007); the web hides the rest

discord.description: Whether "Log in with Discord" is configured (ADR 0008)
Display name of the linked Discord account

createdBy.description: Name of the person who created the invitation

url.description: Link to share. Shown only once.

contract.description: Hash of the API shape (paths + components). The web app compares it with its generated client.

hostPort.description: Port players connect to on the node

players.description: Peak players online; null for games without a player query

settings.description: Changed settings; keys left out keep their value

content.description: null while the file does not exist, e.g. before the first start

type.description: version: pick from GET /templates/versions; modpack: a Modrinth modpack, its name or link

files.description: Files owners and admins can edit

share.description: Pack format for sharing player content (ADR 0018)

online.description: Whether the agent is connected right now

backups.description: Newest first; null while the node is offline

everyHours.description: Hours between scheduled backups; 0 = only by hand

dependency.description: Installed because another project needs it

version.description: The newer version; null if nothing fits the server any more

incompatible.description: No version fits the server's game version

missing.description: Content that cannot be in the pack

fromEnv.description: Set by an environment variable; cannot be changed here

values.description: A value per setting key; null or "" removes it
